page.title: Question of the Day
page.guest: Log in to see the Question of the Day.
page.no_permission: You don't have permission to see the Question of the Day.
page.none_text: The question pool is empty. Suggest one, and it could be tomorrow's.
page.locked: {count, plural, one {# answer is} other {# answers are}} waiting. Post yours to see them all.
page.locked_none: Nobody has answered yet. Be the first!

card.placeholder: Your answer, in a line or two…
card.locked: {count, plural, one {# answer} other {# answers}}, hidden until you post yours
card.others: {count, plural, one {# other answer} other {# other answers}} to read
card.first: You were first! Check back later.

answer.delete_confirm: Delete this answer? Its reactions go with it.
answer.delete_mine_confirm: Delete your answer? You can answer again while the question is up.

streak.title: {count, plural, one {Answered # day in a row} other {Answered # days in a row}}

archive.empty: No past questions yet. Today's will be the first.

queue.guest: Log in to suggest questions and vote for the ones you'd like to see.
queue.suggest_placeholder: Example: What's the best concert you've ever been to?
queue.suggest_help: Keep it short and open: one line anyone can answer. Members vote, moderators approve, and the most popular go first.
queue.suggested: Thanks! Your question is in the queue.
queue.pending_help: Upvote the ones you'd like to answer. A moderator approves them into the pool.
queue.pending_help_mod: Approve a suggestion to put it in the pool, or reject it.

pool.add_placeholder: One question per line. They go straight into the pool.
pool.added: {added, plural, one {# question added} other {# questions added}}{skipped, plural, =0 {} one {, # skipped (too short, too long or already there)} other {, # skipped (too short, too long or already there)}}.
pool.title: The pool
pool.help: Asked in this order at midnight: questions scheduled for a date first, then the most upvoted, then the oldest. Only moderators see this list.
pool.low: The pool is almost empty. Add some questions or approve suggestions so tomorrow has one.
pool.ask_now_locked: Someone already answered today's question: schedule this for another day instead
pool.ask_now_confirm: Put this question up now? Today's goes back into the pool.

streaks.me: Your streak: {current} · best {best} · {total} answered in all

notification.new: Today's Question of the Day is up
notification.asked: Your question is today's Question of the Day!

settings.notify_new: When a new Question of the Day goes up (after you turn on its daily reminder)
settings.notify_asked: When a question I suggested becomes the Question of the Day

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.closed: This question has closed. Here's today's.
errors.answer_length: Your answer is empty or too long.
errors.own_answer: You can't react to your own answer.
errors.own_question: You can't vote for your own question.
errors.duplicate: That question is already in the pool or the queue.
errors.too_many_pending: You have 5 suggestions waiting. Wait for them to be reviewed first.
errors.already_asked: That question has already been asked.
errors.has_votes: Members have voted for this question, so its wording can't change now. Withdraw it and suggest the new wording instead.
errors.date_past: Pick today or a later date.
errors.today_answered: Someone already answered today's question, so it can't be swapped. Schedule this one instead.
errors.slow_down: Slow down a little and try again in a minute.
errors.permission_denied: You don't have permission to do that.

settings.timezone_help: A new question goes up at midnight here. Your browser's timezone is {zone}.
settings.hero: Show the card on the front page
settings.hero_help: Today's question above the discussion list (not on tag pages or searches). Members can hide it until the next question.
settings.nav: Show "Question of the Day" in the sidebar
settings.discussion: Also start a discussion for each question
settings.discussion_help: Posted when the question goes up, with a link to answer it. Answers stay on the Question of the Day page.
settings.tag_help: Needed if your forum requires a tag on new discussions.
settings.poster_help: A username. Leave empty to post as the first administrator.
settings.pool_help: Moderators add questions, approve members' suggestions, schedule and swap questions on the forum.

permissions.view: View the Question of the Day
permissions.suggest: Suggest questions and vote on suggestions

discussion.title: Question of the Day: {question}
discussion.answer: Answer it here (everyone's answers show up once you post yours): {url}

gdpr.export: Your Question of the Day answers, suggested questions and streak.
gdpr.delete: Your Question of the Day answers, reactions, votes, streak and reminder. Questions you suggested stay, without your name.

new.subject: Today's Question of the Day is up
new.hidden: Everyone's answers show up as soon as you post yours.
